The second WMI drop (18:08:22), as 1006-23.

The machine's watchdog read it (it judged the run at 09:52:54 from maafw.log). 10-06 does not test the MaaEnd watchdog / verdict path (design.md section 6, day 3).

Not sent on current code, which judges the four MaaEnd tasks from MaaFW's own steps (records._mark_task_trails), not from task-end screenshots: the corpus holds MaaEnd's debug/maafw.log only from 09:50:02 (seed.json notes, as 1006-27), so none of the four tasks of MaaEnd-05-28-01 (they ended 09:31-09:41) is in it, and a first such run in a row is left unjudged (maaend_fwlog.TRAIL_MISS_FAIL 2): an INFO line (sim relay.log 10-06 09:53:25 「…在终末地自己的记录里读不到…连续第 1 趟；这一趟先不判，写进日报」) and a daily-report note, no 「没证据」 item.
